newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota gives no date for launch of regional car.
newsitem.headline: Toyota gives no date for launch of regional car.

text.p: Officials from Toyota Motor Corp said on Monday they would not comment on a Japanese newspaper report that the company would launch its so-called "Asia Car" in Thailand on January 31.

The Nihon Kogyo Shimbun industrial daily reported on Monday that Toyota would introduce a car for the Asian market in Thailand at the end of January and export that vehicle to Singapore and Brunei in the middle of 1997.
"We cannot disclose the details of the new model until the timing of the launch," a Toyota spokesman said.
In April this year, Toyota said it would launch a passenger car in Thailand as part of a plan to boost output in that country to keep up with increasing demand.
At the same time, Toyota said it would start sales in early 1997 and may export the car to neighbouring countries in the future.

Honda has already launched a new 1,300-cc four-door sedan in Thailand, which the carmaker said was the first new passenger car to be designed and developed to meet the needs of customers in Thailand and Asia.
Nissan, Mitsubishi Motors and Mazda are developing similar cars, industry sources said.
